topic: An emotional animated story of a struggling mango mother abandoned by her onion husband, who still shows kindness to a stranger
notes: make it a mango orange and onion character
title: The Mango Mom Who Gave Everything

reference.transcript: A fancy car! Is that dad? Did he come back for us? Stay behind me, babies. Don't go near the road. Daddy, you came back home. Don't get your hopes up. I'm only here to grab the rest of my things. I'm not staying. Perry, darling, hurry it up. This place smells like dirt. You've been gone for weeks, Perry. The kids barely had anything to eat. That's your problem now. I'm done living in poverty. I'm moving on to bigger things. He has a real woman now, sweetheart. A real woman doesn't smile while children are crying. Mom, is that all we have for dinner? We'll share it tonight, okay? Tomorrow morning? I'll head into town and find a job. You shouldn't have to struggle like this. Just because dad left us. Please, Mr. Leo, I'll clean, restock shelves, sweep, anything. I just need money to feed my children. I'm sorry, Stella. I can't hire someone with all that family drama attached to them. It's bad for business. My children going hungry isn't drama, sir. It's our reality. Mommy, where's your food? Aren't you eating? Oh, I ate earlier while cooking, sweetie. Eat up. No, you didn't. Great. Of all nights for the battery to die. And in the middle of nowhere. Ma'am, come inside quickly before you catch a cold. Oh, dear. You don't even know who I am. I know you're freezing in the rain. That's all that matters. Is this your last cup of tea, dear? Tea always tastes better when it's shared with a guest. Ma'am always gives away what she needs most. She had nothing and gave me everything. Should I change her life? Comment below.

blueprint.hook: A shiny car pulls up! Is that daddy coming home for us?

scenes.narration: A shiny car pulls up! Is that daddy coming home for us?
Stay behind me, little ones. Keep away from the road.
Daddy! You finally came back to us.
Don't get excited. I only came to collect my things. I'm not staying here.
Hurry up, sweetheart. This whole place reeks of mud.
You vanished for weeks. Your children barely had a thing to eat.
That's your burden now. I'm finished living broke. I'm chasing a better life.
He's got a real woman at his side now, honey.
A real woman doesn't grin while little children weep.
Mom, is that really all we have for supper?
We'll share it tonight, okay? Tomorrow I'll go into town and find work.
You shouldn't have to suffer like this just because he left us.
Please, Mr. Banks, I'll clean, stock shelves, anything. I only need to feed my kids.
I'm sorry, Stella. I can't take on someone with all this family drama.
It's simply bad for my business.
My children starving isn't drama, sir. It's our everyday reality.
Mommy, where's your plate? Why aren't you eating too?
Oh, I ate earlier while cooking, sweetie. Go ahead and finish up.
No, you didn't, mom.
Perfect. Of all the nights for this battery to die on me.
And out here in the middle of nowhere.
Ma'am, please come inside quickly before you catch a chill.
You don't even realize who I am, dear.
I know you're freezing out there. That's the only thing that matters.
Is this your very last cup of tea, dear?
Tea always tastes sweeter when it's shared with a guest.
She owned almost nothing, yet she handed me everything.
Should I change her whole life? Comment below.

blueprint.description: A mango mom gave everything despite having nothing. Should her life change? Comment below. Part 2 soon.
